action.question: Which test-coverage phase should we take on?

questions.question: Which test-coverage phase should we take on?

options.label: Phase 1 — Transactions + jobs (#22) (Recommended)
options.description: The intended starting point. Adds TransactionIntegrationTest + ScheduledJobIntegrationTest, hitting the worst-covered classes (TransactionTrait 9%, ScheduledJobController 11%, OperationsController 11%). Targets 55.67% → 65%.

options.label: Phase 2 — Reporting + mail (#23)
options.description: Fund/account report generation (HTML+PDF), FundTrait/AccountTrait, and Mail::fake() coverage. Targets → 72%. Builds on Phase 1 fixtures.

options.label: Phase 3 — Portfolio & assets (#24)
options.description: Trade portfolio create/rebalance + asset price/allocation. Hits PortfolioAssetControllerExt (7%, 321 LOC). Targets → 78%.

options.label: Phase 4 — RBAC (#25)
options.description: Role-based access control, fund-specific permissions, admin vs user. Overlaps with existing AclMatrixTest. Targets → 82%.

transcript_tail.text: I'll check the project board and the repo's issues for test coverage tickets.
`gh` isn't on the PATH. Let me locate it.
Found it — PATH is missing `/opt/homebrew/bin`. I'll use the full path.
There are four "Coverage Phase" test tickets plus a couple of related test ones. Let me read their details.
Let me read the source coverage plan to give you accurate context before we pick.

Here's the picture. There are four sequential test-coverage tickets (#22–25), all sourced from `app1/family-fund-app/test_coverage_plan.md`. The plan starts from a **55.67% line-coverage baseline** and targets **82%** across the four phases:

| Issue | Phase | Targets (worst-covered classes) | Coverage goal |
|-------|-------|-------------------------------|---------------|
| **#22** | 1: Transaction + scheduled jobs | `TransactionTrait` (9%), `ScheduledJobController` (11%), `OperationsController` (11%), `MatchingRuleController` (12%) | → 65% |
| **#23** | 2: Reporting + traits/mail | `FundControllerExt` (3%), `FundTrait` (28%), `AccountTrait` (~41%), report controllers, Mail | → 72% |
| **#24** | 3: Portfolio & asset mgmt | `PortfolioAssetControllerExt` (7%), trade portfolio + asset price controllers | → 78% |
| **#25** | 4: User & access control (RBAC) | `UserRoleController`, `SetFundPermissions`, `AuthorizationService` | → 82% |

The phases are designed to run in order, and Phase 1 hits the absolute lowest-coverage business-logic classes for the biggest single jump.
